race.comment: ABBY'S CROSSWORD (5) has the right blend of recent form and race set-up after a solid second at Mortlake on soft ground, where she covered ground and still made inroads to be beaten two and a half lengths. Her Avoca maiden win before the break was decisive, this looks a nice option. ILIAD (10) resumes with two trials behind her, has three wins around this trip and is capable of running well fresh if ready off the six-month break. KRASNOLUDEK (2) was better than it  looked on paper first up and expecting good improvement second up, while IMMORTAL JUSTICE (8) also has to be included off the soft draw.
